title: Autism spectrum disorder in under 19s: recognition, referral and diagnosis
source: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE)
population: Children and young people from birth up to 19 years in UK guidance context
thai_limitation: Referral guidance can inform clinical review, but it is not a Thai validation source and does not provide Thai transcript feature norms.
referral_context: Consider autism when there are developmental or behavioural concerns, while considering other explanations.
Consider referral based on observed or reported features, severity, duration, cross-setting presence, impact, family concern, and alternative explanations.
